name: Organizational Structure and Processes
description: This course examines how organizational structures and processes shape effectiveness. It explores design choices, coordination mechanisms, and decision-making systems, linking them to strategy and environment. Students learn to diagnose structural and process inefficiencies and apply tools such as process mapping, lean thinking, and digital transformation to improve organizational performance.
